cues: A complaint that sounds angry gets a polite reply and no action.
A complaint that reads like a file note gets acted on, because the reader can see exactly what to put right.
It needs five facts: what you bought or used; when and where; the proof, a bill or order number; what went wrong; and the remedy you want: repair, replacement, refund or apology.
Name one of them, and put the order number in the subject line, where a clerk will look for it.
